home.name: Henri Veesaar
home.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

home.name: Mouhamed Gueye
home.comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

home.name: Jock Landale
home.comment: Landale (hip) won't play Sunday against the Pistons.

home.name: CJ McCollum
home.comment: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

home.name: Asa Newell
home.comment: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

away.name: Jalen Duren
away.comment: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

away.name: Ebuka Okorie
away.comment: Okorie (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Atlanta.

away.name: Taurean Prince
away.comment: Prince (knee) underwent surgery to address lingering issues and has no timeline for a return, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

away.name: Duncan Robinson
away.comment: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

home.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
home.comment: Antetokounmpo (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Oklahoma City, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

away.name: Alex Caruso
away.comment: Caruso (hip) won't play Sunday against the Heat.

away.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
away.comment: Gilgeous-Alexander (back/neck) is listed as out for Sunday's game against the Heat.

away.name: Chet Holmgren
away.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

away.name: Thomas Sorber
away.comment: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

away.name: Nikola Topic
away.comment: Topic (hip) is listed as out for Sunday's game versus the Heat.

away.name: Cason Wallace
away.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

away.name: Jalen Williams
away.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

away.name: Jaylin Williams
away.comment: Williams (back) is listed as out for Sunday's game against Miami.

home.name: Jalen Smith
home.comment: Smith (illness) has been upgraded to probable for Sunday's game against the Nuggets.

home.name: Patrick Williams
home.comment: Williams is probable for Sunday's game against the Nuggets due to a left thumb sprain.

home.name: Nic Claxton
home.comment: Claxton (illness) won't play in Sunday's game against the Nuggets.

home.name: Norman Powell
home.comment: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.

home.name: Caleb Wilson
home.comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

away.name: Julian Strawther
away.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

away.name: P.J. Washington
away.comment: Washington (illness) is doubtful to play Sunday's game against the Jazz.

away.name: Tarik Biberovic
away.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

away.name: Sergio de Larrea
away.comment: De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

away.name: Tobi Lawal
away.comment: Lawal (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jazz.

away.name: Paolo Banchero
away.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

away.name: Jonathan Isaac
away.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

away.name: Izaiyah Nelson
away.comment: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

away.name: Noah Penda
away.comment: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

away.name: Pascal Siakam
away.comment: Siakam (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against New York.

away.name: Johnny Furphy
away.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

away.name: Tyrese Haliburton
away.comment: Haliburton (hamstring) is expected to miss at least two more weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

away.name: T.J. McConnell
away.comment: McConnell (hamstring) is listed as out for Sunday's game in New York.

away.name: Ben Sheppard
away.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

away.name: Paul George
away.comment: George (rest) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Golden State, Justin Turpin of WEEI.com reports.

away.name: Mitchell Robinson
away.comment: Robinson (illness) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Golden State, Justin Turpin of WEEI.com reports.

items.note: Daily Faceoff 1선·1수비 조합과 첫 골리 기준 예상

home.name: Oliver Bjorkstrand
home.comment: Bjorkstrand (upper body) is expected to be sidelined for 2-3 months, Peter Baugh of The Athletic reports Saturday.

home.name: Alberts Smits
home.comment: Smits (upper body) is expected to miss 2-3 months, Peter Baugh of The Athletic reported Saturday.

home.name: Joe Veleno
home.comment: Veleno (lower body) skated on his own before Friday's practice session, Colin Stephenson of Newsday reports.

home.name: Igor Shesterkin
home.comment: Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.

away.name: Nikolaj Ehlers
away.comment: Ehlers (undisclosed) won't play Sunday against the Rangers, per Chip Alexander of The Raleigh News & Observer.
